theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_density_estimates
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, ∃ ρ₁ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₁ ∧ Metric.ball x ρ₁ ⊆ U ∧ ∃ C c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ (n + 1)) ≤ volume (E ∩ Metric.ball x ρ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ (n + 1)) ≤ volume (Metric.ball x ρ \ E)) ∧ Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, ‖ν y - reducedNormal μ ν x‖ ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
